flow_overview: A multi-entry Six Flags recruiting flow that lets applicants select a park, explore park-specific jobs, open a role detail page, and start an application.
capability_summary: Careers entry from general and park-specific pages
Park selection for location-scoped job discovery
Department and role browsing within a park
Detailed job information for specific openings

requirements.text: The system shall present available parks in a browsable location list that helps applicants find the correct property.
requirements.rationale: The flow demonstrates list-based park discovery and selection.

claims.claim: Available parks are presented in a browsable location list.
claims.claim_text: Available parks are presented in a browsable location list.

claims.claim: The browsable location list helps applicants find the correct property.
claims.claim_text: The browsable location list helps applicants find the correct property.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 3 shows a browsable park list grouped by location. Step 4 shows a selected park after using that discovery mechanism.

requirements.text: The system shall make the recruiting flow understandable through consistent labeling of park, team, and role context across screens.
requirements.rationale: The observed labels keep park, team, and role context coherent across the recruiting path.

claims.claim: The recruiting flow uses consistent park-context labeling across screens.
claims.claim_text: The recruiting flow uses consistent park-context labeling across screens.

requirements.evidence_note: The flow repeatedly shows White Water park context, team cards, and a Lifeguard role detail page.

requirements.text: The system shall keep the selected park context attached when an applicant proceeds from recruiting content into the application-start flow for a specific opening.
requirements.rationale: Context attachment is supported up to the chosen opening, while the application-start portion is not captured.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall carry the selected park context into subsequent recruiting screens and park-specific job content.

claims.claim: The selected park context remains attached when an applicant proceeds from recruiting content to a specific opening.

requirements.evidence_note: The flow preserves the park context through the job detail page, but it does not show the application-start flow after Apply now.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a visible handoff into the application process for the chosen role, such as a dedicated application page or explicit confirmation that the selected opening is being applied to.
requirements.rationale: The application entry action is supported, but the handoff outcome is not visible.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall provide a prominent action for starting an application from recruiting content and job-opening pages.

claims.claim: The chosen role has an entry action into the application process.

requirements.text: The system shall let applicants drill into every visible department or team area on a selected park recruiting page to reach openings or recruiting details for that area.
requirements.rationale: The observed drill-in path is supported for one area, but the universal every-area requirement is not fully covered.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall let applicants browse opportunities by department or specialized team within a selected park.

claims.claim_text: Drilling into those areas reaches openings or recruiting details for that area.

requirements.evidence_note: The park recruiting page shows multiple team areas with Apply Now actions, and the flow reaches a Lifeguard opening. The flow does not test every visible team area.

requirements.text: The system shall mark roles as featured or hiring only when those openings are still actively accepting applications.
requirements.rationale: The core only-when correctness condition depends on non-visible job availability or application status.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall highlight featured or currently hiring roles on park recruiting pages to speed job discovery.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a review step that summarizes the selected park and opening before the applicant commits to starting the application.
requirements.rationale: The relevant pre-application screens visibly lack the required review summary.

requirements.rationale: The shown park recruiting page visibly contradicts the stronger direct in-page filtering requirement.
